chunks: From him, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from al-Ḥārith ibn Mughīrah, from ʿUmar ibn Ḥanẓalah, who said:
I was observing the sun in the presence of Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, and he said: “O ʿUmar, shall I not inform you of something clearer than this?” He said: I said: “Yes, may I be made your ransom.”

He said: “When the sun declines, then ẓuhr has commenced, except that before it there is a supererogatory prayer, and that is up to you. So if you shorten it, then it is when you finish your supererogatory prayer; and if you lengthen it, then it is when you finish your supererogatory prayer.”

key_terms.خَفَّفْتَ: you performed it briefly or lightly
key_terms.زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: the sun declined from its zenith, marking the beginning of ẓuhr time
key_terms.سُبْحَةً: a supererogatory prayer performed before the obligatory prayer
key_terms.طَوَّلْتَ: you performed it at greater length

ai.seo_question: When does the time of ẓuhr prayer begin according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that the time of ẓuhr begins as soon as the sun passes the meridian. It also indicates that there is a recommended supererogatory prayer before the obligatory ẓuhr prayer, and its length is left to the worshipper.
